user.title: Ambilight Spotify
user.description: Choose the media player whose album artwork will drive your lights (for example a SpotifyPlus or Spotify Connect player).

lights.title: Lights and behaviour
lights.description: Choose the lights that will take the accent colour of the artwork. Only lights that are already on are changed, and their brightness is never touched.

data.require_entity: Only while this entity is on

data_description.source_filter: Optional. Only sync while the player's source (for example the Spotify Connect device) is one of these. Leave empty to sync with any source.
data_description.require_entity: Optional. Only sync while this entity is on, for example a group of all your lights.
data_description.default_color: Optional. Colour applied to the lights when the sync stops (switch turned off, playback stopped...). Leave empty to keep the last colour.
data_description.transition: Seconds the lights take to change colour.

abort.already_configured: This media player is already configured.

init.title: Lights and behaviour
init.description: Only lights that are already on are changed, and their brightness is never touched.

data_description.source_filter: Optional. Only sync while the player's source (for example the Spotify Connect device) is one of these. Leave empty to sync with any source.
data_description.require_entity: Optional. Only sync while this entity is on, for example a group of all your lights.

entry_not_found.message: No loaded Ambilight Spotify entry with id {entry_id}.

apply.name: Apply colour
apply.description: Re-sends the current accent colour to the lights, or the default colour if the sync is not active. Call it from your own automations, for example after a scene changes.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Ambilight Spotify entry to apply. Leave empty to apply all of them.

entity_id.name: Lights
entity_id.description: Apply to these lights instead of the configured ones. Useful when your scenes decide which lights should follow the music.
